gloss: failure of talks; breakdown in negotiations; rupture

definitions.gloss: failure of talks; breakdown in negotiations; rupture; parting without agreement
definitions.explanation: A situation where discussions or negotiations end without reaching agreement. Both parties leave without resolving the matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{物別|ものわか}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合い：14176_hanashiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平行線|へいこうせん}→平行線：16975_heikousen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま{物別|ものわか}れ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The discussion remained at an impasse and broke down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{労使|ろうし}→労使：27897_roushi⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{物別|ものわか}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わり、ストライキ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: The labor-management negotiations broke down, and the possibility of a strike is growing.

notes:
USAGE:
{物別|ものわか}れ is most commonly used in the pattern {物別|ものわか}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end in failure/without agreement). It implies that neither side made concessions and the matter remains unresolved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物別|ものわか}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end in failure)
- {物別|ものわか}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to break down)
- {物別|ものわか}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧ (negotiations that ended in failure)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{決裂|けつれつ}→決裂：14895_ketsuretsu⟧ means a rupture or breakdown and is a stronger word implying a definitive, often hostile end to talks. {物別|ものわか}れ is milder, suggesting the parties simply parted without reaching agreement.
